construction_notes.text: From the state Housing Element Annual Progress Report, through 2025.

CTCAC CA-25-080: Trillium Senior Apartments, located at 675 East Santa Clara Street in San Jose, requested and is being recommended for a reservation of $2,500,000 in annual federal tax credits and $6,410,255 in total state tax credits to finance the new construction of 64 units of housing serving seniors and special needs tenants with rents affordable to households earning 30%-50% of area median income (AMI). Recorded as a note because this funding covers Trillium Senior Apartments (65 units), which may be one component of this record.

CTCAC CA-25-110: East Santa Clara Senior, located at 675 East Santa Clara Street in San Jose, requested and is being recommended for a reservation of $2,500,000 in annual federal tax credits to finance the new construction of 67 units of housing serving seniors and special needs tenants with rents affordable to households earning 30%-60% of area median income (AMI). Recorded as a note because this funding covers East Santa Clara Senior (68 units), which may be one component of this record.
Phase two: 213 affordable homes in a family building, senior building and 36 townhomes. Trillium Senior Apartments (64 units) is part of the site.

One part of this plan has started: East Santa Clara Senior (68 units, 700 E St John St), which Eden Housing says is part of the East Santa Clara Master Plan, is tracked separately as SCC-000478. Eden's August 2026 release says the partners are breaking ground. No start found for the other parts, so this record's status is unchanged.

City of San Jose permit MP23-008 (Ministerial Permit, folder year 2023), status Approved, issue date 2024-11-18: "SB 35 Ministerial Permit (MP23-008) for the partial demolition of a commercial building (16,965-sf), construction of three, 100% affordable residential projects: a 5-story, senior housing development with 64 units, an 8-story, multifamily development wit" (city text cut off at 255 characters)

City permits layer: MP23-008 (folder 125133) is an SB 35 ministerial permit for partial demolition of a 16,965 sf commercial building and three 100% affordable projects, including a 5-story, 64-unit senior building; T23-029 reconfigures eight lots to five for a 64-unit senior building, a 114-unit large-family building and 36 condominium units. Applicants listed: Eden Housing (MP23-008) and County of Santa Clara (T23-029). Later adjustments AD25-063, AD25-177, AD25-522, AD26-086, AD26-631 approved; AD26-788 under review November 2026.

City permits layer: 2018 fee estimate by Santa Clara County Housing Authority for about 750 residential units and about 300,000 sq ft of commercial/office/retail on a 12.3 gross acre site; PRE20-134 (2020) preliminary review for an office building, two 8-story residential buildings and a 5-story senior building. ER24-163 note: HUD prepared a Part 50 review for the Eden senior portion; Core indicated in May 2026 it does not anticipate HUD funding.

CEQAnet SCH 2025051260: East Santa Clara Townhomes, 36 affordable for-sale townhomes on 3 acres, APNs 467-14-087 and 467-14-052, applicant The Core Companies; lead agency Santa Clara County, responsible agency County Office of Supportive Housing; ministerial exemption under Gov. Code 65913.4.

Architect project page: project number 21916, status In Design; owner/client Santa Clara County Housing Authority; ground-floor retail, public plaza and a paseo from East St. John Street to East Santa Clara Street.
